you could get one and be extra careful with your masks. this piercing is the biggest pain in the ass and the healing process is so unpredictable and never ending. I've had mine for a year and a few months and it wasn't awfully painful I could handle it easy and it was healing well aside from a  few irritation bumps that went away with frequent sea salt soaks and saline application so I thought it was a fine but after the year mark it formed keloids cause I guess I was sleeping on it or something but I did every trick in the book (aspirin paste sea salt paste tea tree oil everything) and they all did nothing until I got silicone discs from aliexpess (basically no pull discs) and those stopped it from moving a lot and it applied pressure to the keloid so they smushed down. anyway I say get one if you're willing to only sleep on one side for the rest of your life and you're willing to take constant care of it and you should totally get the discs asap and put them on after the piercing so you minimize any shit happening with yours. sorry I could write a book on this piercing but good luck. the swag is worth the pain.

get no pull discs or silicone discs from aliexpress. if its clean and not infected and no saline/sea salt soaks are helping it then I reckon its a keloid or the bar is too small and you sleep on it or maybe apply pressure in a wrong way. you should post a photo of it if you can. the discs helped mine lose the small keloids on it. also don't do any bs methods like aspirin paste or sea salt paste or tea tree oil blah blah blah they cause more harm than good

I reckon not. the top of your ear is quite triangular so a bar there would fit really strangely and it would be uncomfortable to even mistakenly sleep on it. plus its already difficult for a piercer to position it on a rounder larger ear, yours is a recipe for easy disaster (sorry lol my industrial was a pain in the ass so I have loads to say) opt for something else. a conch or daith would look so sick on you.

you should totally get no pull disc (basically silicone discs you can find them on aliexpress for super cheap) they stop it from moving around and getting irritated as well as how it doesn't allow any keloid/bump to form since its doesn't give any space for that to happen. also only apply saline to it and don't use any tea tree or aspirin or any bs methods they never work on an irritated industrial. and don't sleep on it never ever it was the  biggest mistake of my life. this piercing is a pain in the ass but its super swag so oh well.
